newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore HSFO seen steady to firm amid thin talks.
newsitem.headline: Singapore HSFO seen steady to firm amid thin talks.

text.p: High sulphur fuel oil prices on Tuesday were expected to be little changed to higher as talks remained thin with most traders mixed about near term market direction, brokers said.
Cst 180 fuel oil supplies for loading in October was bid/asked at $115/$117 per tonne.
"Discussion were thin with traders still mixed on near term direction" said a trader.
While a major appeared to be long on supplies, one other major is still bidding at around $116 per tonne, the trader said.
Prices may track crude to end higher, said another major.
In the swaps market, October fuel oil paper was indicated at $115.00/$115.50, slightly higher from Monday's quotes at $114.50/$115.50, amid slightly softer crude levels.
Chinese enquires were thin, said another trader.
